breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that the torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface. The generated specification correctly includes the torsional shear stress τxy = τ (from torsion) in the plane stress state for part (c), matching the ground truth. The erroneous instruction to make torsional shear vanish is not present in the generated specification.
